page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u0.c1m8.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor, includes a 33 MB L3 cache, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Local storage is not bundled with this instance.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance generally falls into the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng and Geekbench place the instance in the bottom 10% to 25% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth read speeds are also weak, though large block write bandwidth achieves average performance. Cryptographic and database operations, such as Redis SET and Passmark database tests, score in the bottom 25%. However, the instance demonstrates average performance for small-scale LLM inference tasks using a 135M parameter model, though performance drops to the bottom 10% for larger 7B models.

Given the high memory density of 8 GB per vCPU paired with lower-tier CPU compute performance, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency processing. It is suited for memory-optimized tasks such as caching layers, lightweight database operations, and small-scale language model inference. It is less suitable for compute-heavy applications, high-throughput web serving, or intensive data compression tasks due to its weak single-threaded performance.
